list

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit raw JSON of the (unmodified) DeviceInfo  records instead of a formatted table. JSON output omits the live HID snapshot  data — DeviceInfo is intentionally not mutated by snapshot reads (see  ADR-0026).

options.description: Skip the live HID battery snapshot reads —  display tag/category info only, no I/O.

commands.name: show

arguments.name: DEVICE_ID
arguments.description: Device ID (from `devices list -v`).  Quote if it contains backslashes.

commands.description: Run the HID battery enricher against one device and  dump the snapshot.

Battery-aware enumeration. Surfaces system batteries  (laptop, ACPI) AND HID-class UPSs that get tagged via Periphery.Hid's  codec-driven enrichment (ADR-0048). Combines DeviceTags.Battery +  DeviceFilter.WithTag's Category-fallback.

options.name: --ascii

options.description: Number of input reports to read before  exiting. Default: 1.

commands.name: write

options.name: --ascii
options.description: Payload as ASCII string. Supports the escape  sequences \r, \n, \t. Mutually exclusive with --bytes.

options.name: --bytes
options.description: Payload as hex string (e.g. '5132  0D' or '51320D'). Mutually exclusive with --ascii.

options.name: --pad-to
options.description: Pad the payload with zero bytes up to this  length. Default: pad to the device's MaxOutputReportLength so the write  fills a full report. Use 0 to disable padding (send the payload as-is).

options.name: --report
options.description: Report ID to send (decimal or 0x-prefixed  hex). Default: 0.

arguments.name: DEVICE_ID
arguments.description: Device ID (from `devices list -v`)  or raw \\?\ interface path.

commands.description: Send a single output report to a HID device.  Padded to MaxOutputReportLength by default.

Send and receive HID input/output reports (data-plane  I/O). Use this when the device routes its request/response over input/output  reports rather than feature reports — common for vendor-defined HID  surfaces like Megatec-clone UPSs on Cypress 0665 silicon.
Inspect and exercise HID devices directly  (Periphery.Hid).
